Account summary: SprocketIDE Assist builds a JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ + PyCharm) that combines a lightweight local indexer with cloud-backed model serving. Primary ask: low-latency inline completions and streaming in-editor suggestions for large monorepos. They prefer model-version pinning per workspace and deterministic rollbacks for plugin updates.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- "If completion lags by >100ms users notice it — retention drops" (CTO)
- "Must be able to run the indexer on the developer's machine or within customer's build cluster; code can't be uploaded to third-party storage" (privacy lead)

POC scope: 
- Integrate Redwood SDK into plugin shim (prototype branch by 2026-02-10)
- Local indexer runs as background process; plugin sends short prefix queries + workspace-id to Redwood routing layer for model selection
- Measure 95th-percentile latency for completions (goal < 120ms), throughput for streaming updates, token costs per 10k completions

Security / compliance:
- SSO/SAML required for enterprise installs, audit log retention 1 year, keys must be customer-managed KMS for Private deployment. Data residency required for EU customers — looking at Private with regional control.

Technical preferences / notes:
- Prefer hosted_api for quick tests but want Private for enterprise customers and some early customers for residency reasons. Interested in Dedicated for predictable latency for team editions.
- Model pinning: want to pin a lightweight, quantized completion model for offline dev mode and route heavy-context queries to stronger hosted models.
- Cache strategy: prefix/KV caching at plugin-level; fallback to smaller local model for offline.
